messages.text: Hi there. I'm Sarah, an AI researcher with Helium Deploy. Thank you so much for taking 15 minutes to do this. It really means a lot. Honestly, the more you can share with me, the better. We're aiming for about 1000 words of feedback together, so please don't worry about going long. The founders read every word of these chats. So what you say actually shapes what HDW does next. As a thank you, you'll get a 75 dollar discount code at the end. So to kick us off, what brought you to HD recently?
